newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market not established - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market not established - USDA.

text.p: Steers and heifers were not established early Monday on a dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights), USDA said.
Dressed Basis Steers: No confirmed sales.
Dressed Basis Heifers: No confirmed sales.
Trade on slaughter steers and heifers was slow. Prices not fully established on either class on a live basis. Buyer inquiry fair, seller interest limited.
Live basis sales: Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink.
Slaughter Steers: Few Select and Choice 2-3 1250 lbs 66.00.
Slaughter Heifers: Few Select and Choice 2-3 1150 lbs 66.00.
